title: Determination 2015/019: CCC refusal for a 13-year-old house with masonry veneer, Langs Beach, Whangarei
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: Building Code current at the time the consent was issued (wording p.18 §8.1); edition number not captured

facts.text: M Norton (owner, applicant) and Whangarei District Council (authority) concern a CCC for a 13-year-old house with masonry veneer at 1178D Cove Road, Langs Beach, Waipu.
A 2007 notice to fix contained several items; items later resolved are excluded, and the determination is limited to the remaining item and items added later.
The authority's certifying contractor and engineering contractor approved the documentation and construction on the authority's behalf.

The summary lists items from Table 2 (items 3 to 6 shown): ventilation of the top of the veneer cavities; glass safety film position; solid reinforced blockwork with an engineer's report that does not address cracking; and a deck balustrade plastered to the wall without a gap, so a saddle flashing is still needed (a second balustrade support point is cut off in extraction).

limitations: Decision begins on p.18 §8.1; mask p.18 for blind use.
